content: This medication can pass into breast milk. Drug interactions may alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. It is important to maintain a list of all products you use, including prescription, non-prescription, and herbal products, and share this information with your doctor and pharmacist. This medication may interfere with certain laboratory tests, such as liver function tests, potentially leading to false results. In the event of an overdose, if the individual exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. To prevent the transmission of hepatitis B to others, always use an effective barrier method, such as latex condoms or dental dams, during sexual activity. Regular laboratory and medical tests, including liver function tests, blood chemistries, complete blood counts, and hepatitis B virus DNA levels, should be conducted while taking this medication. Different brands of this medication may contain varying amounts of the active ingredient. Do not switch brands without consulting your doctor. If you have an HIV infection, you should be prescribed the higher-strength dosage. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is close to the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Storage requirements for this medication may vary depending on the brand. Refer to the product packaging for specific storage instructions or consult your pharmacist. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information was last revised in May 2024. It is a summary and does not contain all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for professional medical advice. Always consult your healthcare provider for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
